body.statement: For every \(G\) and finite \(\mathcal J\), \(\mathcal A_{G,\mathcal J}^{\mathrm{raw}}=\mathcal A_{G,\mathcal J}^{\mathrm{fac-q}}\subseteq\mathcal A_{G,\mathcal J}^{\mathrm{simp-q}}\). More precisely, for every \(\lambda\in\Lambda_G\), push-forward gives \(\mathbb E_{\mu_{\lambda}}[T_{G,\mathcal J}]=\mathbb E_{(\pi_{G,\mathcal J})_{\#}\mu_{\lambda}}[\overline T_{G,\mathcal J}]\), and every member of \(\overline{\mathcal P}_{G,\mathcal J}^{\mathrm{fac}}\) arises this way. Thus only replacement of the induced factorized quotient family by the unrestricted branchwise quotient simplex can enlarge the projected image.
body.justification: This isolates the only dangerous step: push-forward itself is exact, whereas freeing quotient-cell masses can erase the nonlinear latent-factor constraints.
body.gap: The unrestricted-simplex lifts in RossettoAntonucci2026 and ChoeEtAl2026 establish linear-program fidelity but do not establish membership in the induced independent-edge-latent quotient family.
body.consumer: The quotient search can test the unrestricted reduced program against a precisely defined sound factorized benchmark.
